title: DiagnosticRun.v1
description: One run of a sales diagnostic (task-sprawl, chatbot-guardrail, openhub-audit). Records the authorization basis and input source. A run that targets a third-party LIVE system must carry authorization_basis=written_authorization, or it is blocked. Inputs that are customer-provided/own-system/public-static-metadata are allowed.

is_live_probe.description: true = sent traffic to a third-party live system (requires written_authorization)
